scientific_integrity: Two independent exact-rational examples and 10556 numerical cases supplement an all-parameter analytic proof. Existing Kantorovich-angle and oblique-projection facts are explicitly acknowledged as classical. Non-exhaustive literature search leaves a risk of equivalent older projector-angle formulations.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric positive definite matrix, exactly one sketched GMRES(1) step, exact arithmetic, and a squared-norm embedding on span{r,Ar}. The bound and safety threshold are deterministic worst-case results, not typical randomized-sketch guarantees. No later-step or finite-precision assertion.
title: Sharp true-residual frontier for one-step SPD sketched GMRES
